title: Cart Abandonment Revenue Leak: Recover Lost Ecommerce Sales
description: How cart abandonment creates revenue leakage — benchmarks, recovery emails, checkout fixes, and dollar impact estimates.

faq.q: How much revenue is lost to cart abandonment?
faq.a: Industry averages often cite 60–80% abandonment. On $50k monthly GMV, recovering even 5% of abandoned carts can mean thousands per month.
Guest checkout, transparent shipping costs early, trust badges, and a 3-email recovery sequence within 72 hours.

blocks.text: Cart abandonment is one of the clearest revenue leaks in ecommerce: intent was real, payment did not happen. The fix is usually recovery plus checkout friction — not more traffic.

items: Shipping or tax surprise at checkout
Stock or variant confusion on PDP
